thread:
incident-bot: Pager: elevated 5xx + timeouts on /v1/stream (us-west-2). 5m error rate = 5.2% (baseline ~0.25%). Multiple streaming sessions reporting truncated chunks and abrupt closes. Paging @chris for oncall. Links: grafana https://grafana.redwood.example/d/streaming, traces https://sentry.redwood.example/issue/9881 :rotating_light:
chris: on it. grabbing logs and current deploys.
maya: I'm seeing a correlated spike in gateway 502/504s beginning ~2123456900. Gateway logs show many upstream read timeouts and "chunked_encoding_truncated" markers.
jake: samples from gateway and stream-handler:
```[gateway] 2026-03-14T03:25:12Z upstream read error: client_closed; chunked_encoding_truncated
[stream-handler] conn=215 client=acct-103 eof=true client_cancel=true
[model-proxy] 504 Upstream read timeout from inference-node-7
```
emma: customer impact q: which tenants hit hardest? initial scan: acct-103, acct-42, acct-271 with >1% failure in last 10m. Mostly chat streaming endpoints with long-lived tool outputs.
beth: any recent infra changes? kernel, envoy, or runtime tweaks?
chris: small change pushed ~2123456800: decreased `upstream_idle_timeout` in envoy from 60s -> 15s to free sockets faster after aborted streams. rolling that back now.
ops-bot: revert-envoy-config started by chris at 2123457005. CI status: [32mOK[0m. rollout: 0/4 -> 4/4.
maya: after revert there's an initial drop in errors (5.2% -> 2.6%) but still elevated. Some requests still show abrupt TCP FIN/RST right after final chunk, clients report partial responses.
jake: tcpdump snippet shows client receiving final chunk then `RST` from upstream shortly after, missing final CRLF sometimes. Example:
```
...Transfer-Encoding: chunked

7
message
0

<< upstream FIN then RST before client ACK of final CRLF >>
```
chris: two hypotheses: (1) inference node process hitting OOM or hitting per-request write timeout and closing socket; (2) gateway aggressive connection pruning.
emma: can we pull memory/oom metrics?
maya: inference-node-7 has 3 OOM kills in the last 20m and one core dump. Also model write latency P95 jumped from 200ms -> 1.5s around the event window.
beth: OOMs explain truncated streams. half-open -> truncated chunk. If many streams keep buffer growth, it can propagate to other instances.
chris: mitigation steps I'm enacting: 1) rollback envoy idle timeout (done), 2) temporally increase upstream request timeout to 120s, 3) scale up inference pool by 30%, 4) cordon & take node-7 out of service for forensic. executing now.
ops-bot: runbook:
```
# scale inference
infractl scale pool inference-streaming --replicas 28
# cordon node
infractl cordon node inference-node-7 --reason="oom-investigation"
```
jake: scale executed at 2123457040, cordon completed at 2123457048. new replicas scheduling.
maya: after scaling, OOMs stop on node-7 (no further kills), P95 model write latency recovers to ~220ms, error rate down to ~0.9% after 2m. residual client cancels (~0.25%) probably due to client-side timeouts triggered earlier.
emma: proposed customer message: "We identified and mitigated an issue causing truncated streaming responses for a subset of long-lived streams. Actions: scaled inference pool, reverted proxy timeout change, cordoned affected node. Monitoring ongoing. If you see repeated truncated responses, please contact support@redwood.example." ok to send to impacted accounts?
chris: go ahead and send to acct-103, acct-42, acct-271 and post on status page. I'll add a short technical blurb.
beth: SDK mitigation: recommend increasing client read timeout to 90s temporarily and enable last-frame retry where semantic-safe. Add a note in release notes.
jake: captured core and heap profile from inference-node-7; initial triage points to a memory accumulation in streaming buffer when tool-call chains are long. Filing runtime issue: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/issues/4329 with profile attached.
chris: handoff: I need to step out in ~20m. handing oncall to emma for follow-up and customer comms. emma, you own RCA and postmortem.
emma: ack, taking over. triggering synthetic streaming e2e job to validate chunked end-to-end: http://ci.redwood.example/streaming-e2e job 5490 triggered.
ops-bot: synthetic test started (job=5490).
maya: notes for postmortem: align envoy idle_timeout with model write timeouts, add alert for streaming chunk-truncate rate, add OOM spike alert on inference nodes, and add integrity checks for chunked transfer completeness in gateway logs.
beth: recommend short-term circuit breaker on model variants that show repeated buffer growth to prevent cascading OOMs. Also add a graceful drain to let clients finish current chunk.
chris: thanks all. current status: mitigations applied (revert + scale + timeout bump) -> error rate back near baseline. monitoring in watch. leaving channel. :thumbsup:
emma: will produce incident summary + RCA draft by EOD and link here. closing thread when postmortem link is posted.
incident-bot: incident entered watch state (closed).
